purpose.summary: This is a COBOL validation test program from the NIST CCVS85 test suite (split from SQ129A). It tests sequential file handling, specifically verifying the correct runtime response when attempting to OPEN a sequential tape/file for INPUT when the file is not present. It writes results to a print/report file.

notable_features: NIST CCVS85 conformance test suite program
FILE STATUS clause (SQ-FS1-STATUS) for sequential file error checking
Sequence numbers in columns 1-6 with program-id watermark in columns 73-80
Commented-out (*P) indexed file SELECT and FD entries for RAW-DATA
Commented-out (*C) LABEL RECORDS clauses (COBOL-85 removed requirement)
REDEFINES used extensively for numeric display formatting in test results
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
53 PERFORMs and 17 GOTOs typical of CCVS boilerplate test harness
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars (~256 of 625 lines). The program-id in the sequence field is SQ1414 (version .2), while PROGRAM-ID paragraph names it SQ141A — consistent with CCVS85 naming conventions. The 'Linux' SOURCE/OBJECT-COMPUTER entries suggest this was adapted from the original NIST suite for a Linux/GnuCOBOL environment. All 625 lines are exactly 80 characters wide (fixed format with no blank lines), which is characteristic of CCVS test programs.
